answer.rationale: The primary region write-path degradation coincides with a release that went out 2 hours ago. With settlement traffic at daily peak and only one intervention slot available, a rollback targets the most likely root cause. Pulling memory_b1 will confirm that prior rollbacks of this kind cleared checkout-class error spikes with no customer impact, validating that this action is safe under the current peak. Capacity add, circuit breaker, read-replica routing, and failover all carry higher cost or weaker fit: failover is regional but the degradation is already confined to the primary region (failover would also interrupt the heavy settlement writes the objective asks us to preserve); capacity add on the write path is slow under a peak; circuit breaker on writes risks losing customer writes, which the primary objective forbids.
